description: READ-REFRESH and TXN-VIEW, the exact boundary and its dependence on dbPageTimeout (both first-card samples were 4.1 s old and 5.5 s new; with PageTimeout 1000 the change appeared between 2.1 and 4.1 s). Process b holds a dynaset and a table cursor on rows 1, 2, 64; a updates N of row 1 by an implicit statement; b waits 3 s and looks every 250 ms until 6 s (Move 0, read, a new snapshot of row 1, each look bracketed by a Signal mark). b then sets SetOption(dbPageTimeout, 2000), opens a second held set, a updates again, and b looks at 0.5 s steps (and 250 ms steps from 1.5 to 2.5 s) up to 5.5 s. Asks the first look at which each cursor kind shows the new value in both settings. Each look is an observation that may itself refresh.
